senses.gloss: The twenty-seventh consonant of the Nāgarī Alphabet, corresponding to the letter R.

m. (रः)
1 Fire or Agni.
2 Heat, warmth.
3 Burning, scorching.
4 Love, desire.
5 Speed.
f. (-रा)
1 Giving.
2 Gold.
f. (री)
Going, moving.
E.
रा to give, रम to play, &c., aff. ड.

r. 2nd cl. (राति)
1 To get, to gain, to receive.
2 To give.
